part.text: Found the likely bug in `getPagesInSection` — `otherBranch` only remembers the *last* branch prefix, so descendants of a previously visited branch (e.g. `/s1/p1` after `/s1-foo` was seen) get included. Let me verify the walk logic and fix it.

The bug is confirmed: `otherBranch` is overwritten when the next branch (`/s1-foo`) is walked, so descendants of an earlier branch (`/s1/p1`) are no longer skipped. I'll track all visited branch prefixes instead of just the last one:

package hugolib

import (
	"testing"

	qt "github.com/frankban/quicktest"
)

func TestTmpAdjacentSectionNames(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	files := `
-- config.toml --
disableKinds = ['rss','sitemap','taxonomy','term']
-- layouts/_default/list.html --
__|{{ range .Pages }}{{ .Title }}|{{ end }}__
-- layouts/_default/single.html --
{{ .Title }}|
-- content/s1/_index.md --
---
title: s1
---
-- content/s1/p1.md --
---
title: p1
---
-- content/s1-foo/_index.md --
---
title: s1-foo
---
-- content/s1/p2.md --
---
title: p2
---
  `

	b := NewIntegrationTestBuilder(
		IntegrationTestConfig{
			T:           t,
			TxtarString: files,
		},
	).Build()

	b.AssertFileContent("public/index.html", "__|s1|s1-foo|__")
	b.AssertFileContent("public/s1/index.html", "__|p1|p2|__")
}

func TestTmpAdjacentSectionNamesDeep(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	files := `
-- config.toml --
disableKinds = ['rss','sitemap','taxonomy','term']
-- layouts/_default/list.html --
{{ range .Pages }}{{ .Title }}|{{ end }}
-- content/s1/_index.md --
---
title: s1
---
-- content/s1/sub/_index.md --
---
title: s1sub
---
-- content/s1/sub/deep.md --
---
title: deep
---
-- content/s1-foo/_index.md --
---
title: s1-foo
---
-- content/s1-foo/leaf.md --
---
title: leaf
---
  `

	b := NewIntegrationTestBuilder(
		IntegrationTestConfig{
			T:           t,
			TxtarString: files,
		},
	).Build()

	b.AssertFileContent("public/index.html", "s1|s1-foo|")
	b.AssertFileContent("public/s1/index.html", "s1sub|")
	b.AssertFileContent("public/s1/sub/index.html", "deep|")
	b.AssertFileContent("public/s1-foo/index.html", "leaf|")
	_ = qt.IsNil
}

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `getPagesInSection` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:332): during a non-recursive tree walk, a single `otherBranch` variable remembered only the *last* branch prefix. When a walk hit `/s1` (branch) then `/s1-foo` (branch), the variable was overwritten, so descendants of `/s1` like `/s1/p1` were no longer skipped and leaked into the parent's `.Pages`.

The fix tracks all visited branch prefixes in a slice and skips any key matching any of them. Verified with a reproduction of the issue's test case (now asserting `__|s1|s1-foo|__`), plus nested-section variants; the full `./hugolib/`, `./resources/page/...`, `./common/paths/...`, and `./hugofs/...` suites all pass.
